papers.title: Mapping Bacteriophage-Based Antimicrobial Research in Southeast Asia: A Bibliometric Analysis of Scientific Productivity, Knowledge Structure, and Emerging Research Pathways.
papers.authors: Ong, Christian Joseph N; Cabalbag, Johnalie N; Cruz, Jowi Tsidkenu Pili; Valderama, Teodora T; Roslin, Celia R; Magtibay, Carina M; Lonogan, Janice Kaylyn K; Libres, Amelda C; Matamis, Joel G; Mamaat, Jose Edwardo R; Mortel, Ferdinand A; Bacalzo, Grace D; Cabuhat, Kevin Smith P; de Leon, Carlos S; Nuevo, Jose Jurel M; Aguilan, Joel R; Fortaleza, Jamil Allen G
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文是对东南亚噬菌体抗菌研究的文献计量学分析，虽提及CRISPR相关方法为新兴主题，但对象非CRISPR/碱基编辑/交错切割，且无分子机制研究，仅宏观趋势描述，与本课题关联极弱。
papers.abstract: Southeast Asia faces a substantial burden of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), creating increasing interest in bacteriophage-based antimicrobial strategies. However, the regional development, contributors, collaboration patterns, and evolving research priorities of this field remain insufficiently characterized. This study conducted a bibliometric analysis of Scopus-indexed publications on bacteriophage-based antimicrobial research affiliated with Southeast Asian countries from 1981 to 2025. Bibliometrix/Biblioshiny and VOSviewer were used to evaluate scientific production, citation patterns, leading contributors, collaboration networks, and conceptual and thematic development. A total of 862 publications were analyzed, with scientific output accelerating markedly after 2019 and reaching its highest level in 2025. Thailand emerged as the dominant regional contributor, with Vongkamjan (n = 21) and Surachat (n = 20) as the two most prolific authors. Mahidol University (n = 182), Prince of Songkla University (n = 142), and Universiti Putra Malaysia (n = 139) were the leading institutions, demonstrating a concentration of research capacity in Thailand and Malaysia. Scientific Reports was the most productive journal (30 publications), whereas Frontiers in Microbiology recorded the highest citation count among the leading sources (963 citations). Collaboration mapping revealed increasingly interconnected regional and international research networks. Thematic analyses demonstrated a transition from foundational and pathogen-specific investigations toward AMR, bacteriophage therapy, biofilm control, aquaculture, genomic and comparative genomic analysis, wastewater and public-health applications, and One Health-oriented research. Emerging topics included endolysins, quorum sensing, CRISPR-associated approaches, metagenomics, and genome-informed phage characterization. These findings demonstrate the rapid expansion and thematic diversification of bacteriophage-based antimicrobial research in Southeast Asia while highlighting persistent geographic concentration and the need for stronger regional infrastructure, collaboration, and translational capacity.
papers.abstract_zh: 东南亚地区面临显著的抗菌药物耐药性（antimicrobial resistance, AMR）负担，这引发了对基于噬菌体的抗菌策略日益增长的兴趣。然而，该领域的区域发展、贡献者、合作模式及演变中的研究重点仍未得到充分表征。本研究对1981年至2025年间Scopus索引的、与东南亚国家相关的基于噬菌体的抗菌研究出版物进行了文献计量分析。使用Bibliometrix/Biblioshiny和VOSviewer评估科学产出、引文模式、主要贡献者、合作网络以及概念和主题发展。共分析了862篇出版物，科学产出在2019年后显著加速，并于2025年达到最高水平。泰国成为区域主要贡献者，其中Vongkamjan（n = 21）和Surachat（n = 20）是两位最多产的作者。玛希隆大学（n = 182）、宋卡王子大学（n = 142）和马来西亚博特拉大学（n = 139）是领先机构，显示出研究能力集中在泰国和马来西亚。《Scientific Reports》是产出最多的期刊（30篇出版物），而《Frontiers in Microbiology》在主要来源中记录了最高引文数（963次引用）。合作图谱揭示了日益互联的区域和国际研究网络。主题分析显示，研究从基础性和病原体特异性调查向AMR、噬菌体疗法、生物膜控制、水产养殖、基因组和比较基因组分析、废水与公共卫生应用以及“One Health”导向研究转变。新兴主题包括内溶素、群体感应、CRISPR相关方法、宏基因组学和基于基因组的噬菌体表征。这些发现表明，东南亚基于噬菌体的抗菌研究正在快速扩展和主题多样化，同时突显了持续存在的地理集中性，以及对更强区域基础设施、合作和转化能力的迫切需求。

papers.title: Structure-guided identification of catalytic determinants in ZmGA20ox enables rational CRISPR target selection for gibberellin engineering in maize.
papers.authors: Kumar B V, Uday; H S, Sowmya; Praba, U Preethi; P S, Gajala; Kaur, Jessica; S, Shashank; Sandhu, Surinder K; Sharma, Priti; Rangu, Chandrashekar; Vikal, Yogesh
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究用结构预测、分子对接、MD模拟和体外CRISPR/Cas9切割实验，鉴定玉米GA20ox3催化关键残基并筛选编辑靶点；虽以CRISPR/Cas9为工具，但核心对象是植物代谢酶而非CRISPR/碱基编辑机制本身，机制深度有限，仅作靶点可行性验证。
papers.abstract: Gibberellin 20-oxidase is a key enzyme controlling gibberellin biosynthesis and represents an attractive target for engineering plant architecture and drought tolerance in maize. In this study, we developed a structure-guided computational workflow to investigate functionally important residues in maize gibberellin 20-oxidase 3 (ZmGA20ox3), integrating AI-based structural prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vitroCRISPR/Cas9 guide RNA cleavage analysis. Structural analysis revealed the conserved Fe(2)(+)-binding catalytic triad (His147-Asp149-His166) surrounded by an aromatic substrate-recognition pocket comprising Phe151, Trp157, and Phe163. Docking analyses showed that native gibberellin substrates and the co-substrate 2-oxoglutarate occupied the predicted catalytic cavity, while prohexadione exhibited the most favourable predicted docking score among the tested ligands. Computational mutagenesis revealed generally less favourable predicted docking scores for the catalytic-site substitutions H147A, D149A, and H166A, whereas substitutions at aromatic substrate-recognition residues produced ligand-dependent effects. Subsequent 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations revealed distinct ligand-dependent conformational behaviours, with H147A affecting the stability of the predicted catalytic environment, whereas W157A primarily influenced ligand accommodation within the substrate-binding pocket. MM/GBSA analyses further indicated that favourable predicted ligand interactions do not necessarily imply a catalytically competent active-site configuration, highlighting the importance of productive active-site organization. Finally, in vitro CRISPR/Cas9 cleavage assays demonstrated sequence-specific cleavage of guide RNAs targeting the ZmGA20ox3 regions containing H147 and W157, supporting the feasibility of targeting these sites in subsequent genome-editing experiments. Collectively, this study provides structure-guided computational insights into the potential roles of key residues in ZmGA20ox3 and establishes a predictive framework for prioritizing candidate residues for future biochemical and genome-editing validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 赤霉素20-氧化酶是控制赤霉素生物合成的关键酶，也是改造玉米植株结构和耐旱性的有吸引力的靶点。在本研究中，我们开发了一种结构引导的计算工作流程，以研究玉米赤霉素20-氧化酶3（ZmGA20ox3）中功能重要的残基，整合了基于AI的结构预测、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外CRISPR/Cas9引导RNA切割分析。结构分析揭示了保守的Fe(2)(+)-结合催化三联体（His147-Asp149-His166），其周围是由Phe151、Trp157和Phe163组成的芳香族底物识别口袋。对接分析表明，天然赤霉素底物和辅底物2-氧戊二酸占据了预测的催化腔，而调环酸钙（prohexadione）在测试配体中表现出最有利的预测对接分数。计算突变分析显示，催化位点替换H147A、D149A和H166A通常产生较不利的预测对接分数，而芳香族底物识别残基的替换则产生配体依赖性效应。随后的100 ns分子动力学模拟揭示了不同的配体依赖性构象行为，其中H147A影响预测催化环境的稳定性，而W157A主要影响底物结合口袋内的配体容纳。MM/GBSA分析进一步表明，有利的预测配体相互作用并不一定意味着催化活性位点构型，强调了生产性活性位点组织的重要性。最后，体外CRISPR/Cas9切割实验证明，靶向包含H147和W157的ZmGA20ox3区域的引导RNA具有序列特异性切割，支持在后续基因组编辑实验中靶向这些位点的可行性。总体而言，本研究为ZmGA20ox3中关键残基的潜在作用提供了结构引导的计算见解，并建立了一个预测框架，用于优先选择候选残基进行未来的生化和基因组编辑验证。

papers.title: The novel function of the bZIP transcription factor VSF-1 in mediating fruit firmness in tomato.
papers.authors: Wang, Chunfeng; Zhang, Kangchi; Lv, Shouzheng; Lin, Yifan; Su, Guanqing; Liu, Zimeng; Lin, Xiahui; Shu, Xiu; He, Zhiren; Bouzayen, Mondher; Hu, Guojian; Shi, Yanna; Chen, Kunsong
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CRISPR-Cas9敲除番茄bZIP转录因子VSF-1并研究其对果实硬度的调控，虽使用了CRISPR工具但仅作为基因敲除手段，未涉及切割机制、碱基编辑或交错断裂等本课题核心机制。
papers.abstract: Fruit firmness is a critical quality trait primarily governed by the structure and composition of the cell wall. While extensive research has focused on firmness dynamics during fruit ripening, the regulatory mechanisms governing its establishment during early fruit development remain poorly understood. Previous studies have demonstrated that VASCULAR SPECIFICITY FACTOR 1 (VSF-1), a member of the bZIP family, is activated in vitro by the key fruit softening regulator LOB1, suggesting its potential role in the regulation of fruit firmness. In this study, we generated both CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout and overexpression lines in tomato; functional analysis revealed that the loss of VSF-1 function reduced fruit firmness, whereas its overexpression enhanced it, thereby establishing VSF-1 as a positive regulator of firmness. By integrating transcriptomic and DNA affinity purification sequencing profiling, we delineated the VSF-1-controlled gene regulatory network associated with cell wall remodeling and identified the beta-galactosidase gene, TBG6, as a direct target. Our findings uncover a novel role for VSF-1 in the transcriptional regulation of tomato fruit texture, underscore the functional diversification within the Solanaceae bZIP subfamily I, and provide new insights into the genetic improvement of fruit quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 果实硬度是一个关键品质性状，主要受细胞壁结构和组成调控。尽管大量研究聚焦于果实成熟期间的硬度动态变化，但调控其早期发育阶段建立的机制仍知之甚少。先前研究表明，bZIP家族成员维管特异性因子1（VSF-1）在体外被关键果实软化调控因子LOB1激活，提示其在果实硬度调控中可能发挥作用。在本研究中，我们生成了番茄中CRISPR-Cas9介导的敲除和过表达株系；功能分析揭示，VSF-1功能缺失降低了果实硬度，而其过表达则增强了硬度，从而确立VSF-1为硬度的正调控因子。通过整合转录组学和DNA亲和纯化测序分析，我们描绘了VSF-1控制的与细胞壁重塑相关的基因调控网络，并鉴定出β-半乳糖苷酶基因TBG6为直接靶标。我们的发现揭示了VSF-1在番茄果实质地转录调控中的新作用，强调了茄科bZIP亚家族I内的功能分化，并为果实品质的遗传改良提供了新见解。

papers.title: CRISPR-Cas9 and precision editing technologies linking functional genomics to clinical translation in genetic diseases.
papers.authors: Wen, Zijing; Su, Jianming
papers.one_liner_zh: 这是一篇综述，概述CRISPR-Cas9及衍生精准编辑工具在遗传病中从功能基因组学到临床转化的应用框架，虽涉及碱基编辑和编辑策略选择，但缺乏对切割/编辑分子机制的深入探讨，机制深度不足。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: CRISPR-Cas9 and derivative precision-editing platforms increasingly connect pathogenic variant interpretation with functional genomics and therapeutic development in genetic diseases. This narrative review focuses on a variant-mechanism-driven framework for matching editing strategies to mutation structure, functional consequence, disease-model evidence, delivery feasibility, safety risk, and translational readiness. MAIN BODY: The review summarizes how monogenic, polygenic, coding, non-coding, mitochondrial, and complex disease contexts influence the choice of canonical Cas9 editing, base editing, prime editing, Cas variants, CRISPR interference/activation, epigenome editing, and disease-model systems. It further compares ex vivo and in vivo delivery routes, safety assessment strategies, immunogenicity and genotoxicity concerns, and clinical implementation barriers, including CMC/manufacturing scalability, long-term follow-up, affordability, and regulatory oversight. Current evidence supports the clinical maturity of ex vivo hematopoietic editing, whereas most in vivo and precision-repair approaches remain constrained by delivery, durability, product heterogeneity, and safety uncertainties. CONCLUSION: The central conclusion is that future CRISPR-based interventions should be judged not only by editability, but by whether molecular correction can be translated into durable, safe, manufacturable, and clinically meaningful benefit.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：CRISPR-Cas9及其衍生的精准编辑平台日益将致病性变异解读与功能基因组学和遗传病治疗开发联系起来。本叙述性综述聚焦于一种基于变异机制的框架，用于将编辑策略与突变结构、功能后果、疾病模型证据、递送可行性、安全性风险及转化就绪度相匹配。主体内容：本综述总结了单基因、多基因、编码区、非编码区、线粒体及复杂疾病背景如何影响经典Cas9编辑、碱基编辑、先导编辑、Cas变体、CRISPR干扰/激活、表观基因组编辑及疾病模型系统的选择。进一步比较了离体和体内递送途径、安全性评估策略、免疫原性和基因毒性问题，以及临床实施障碍，包括CMC/制造可扩展性、长期随访、可负担性和监管监督。当前证据支持离体造血编辑的临床成熟度，而大多数体内和精准修复方法仍受限于递送、持久性、产品异质性和安全性不确定性。结论：核心结论是，未来基于CRISPR的干预措施不仅应依据可编辑性来评判，还应考虑分子校正能否转化为持久、安全、可制造且具有临床意义的获益。

papers.title: Towards precision antileishmanial drug discovery: Integrating multi-omics, functional genomics, artificial intelligence and host-directed therapeutics.
papers.authors: Topuz Ata, Derya; Ata, Anil; Odaci, Zeynep Tuba
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述整合多组学、CRISPR功能基因组学、AI和宿主导向疗法用于抗利什曼原虫药物发现，CRISPR仅作为筛选工具，未涉及切割/碱基编辑分子机制，与本课题关联弱。
papers.abstract: Leishmaniasis remains one of the most neglected tropical diseases, affecting millions of people worldwide and posing a substantial public health burden in endemic regions. Current treatment options are limited by toxicity, high costs, prolonged treatment regimens, treatment failure, and the increasing emergence of drug-resistant parasites. Moreover, the remarkable genomic plasticity and adaptive capacity of Leishmania species, driven by mosaic aneuploidy and copy number variation, complicate durable target identification and underscore the need for precision-oriented therapeutic approaches. Recent developments in multi-omics strategies, CRISPR-based genome engineering, artificial intelligence, and host-directed therapeutics are transforming precision antileishmanial drug discovery. In this review, we explore how multi-omics technologies uncover pathways involved in parasite survival, virulence, and drug resistance. We examine the contributions of CRISPR-based technologies to functional genomic screening, target validation, and investigation of resistance mechanisms. Complementing these approaches, AI-assisted predictive modelling supports target prioritisation, virtual screening, and structure-guided drug discovery. We also discuss host-directed immunotherapy as a complementary strategy to parasite-directed therapies. Particular focus is placed on high-priority therapeutic pathways regulating redox homeostasis, sterol biosynthesis, MAP kinase signalling, mitochondrial electron transport, and arginine metabolism. Taken together, these strategies offer an integrated framework connecting target discovery, functional validation, computational prioritisation, and host immune modulation, while supporting a precision-oriented approach for the development of safer, more efficient, and resistance-resilient antileishmanial therapies.
papers.abstract_zh: 利什曼病仍然是最被忽视的热带病之一，影响着全球数百万人，并在流行地区构成重大的公共卫生负担。目前的治疗方案受到毒性、高成本、疗程延长、治疗失败以及耐药寄生虫日益增多的限制。此外，利什曼原虫物种显著的基因组可塑性和适应能力，由镶嵌非整倍性（mosaic aneuploidy）和拷贝数变异（copy number variation）驱动，使持久靶点的识别复杂化，并凸显了精准导向治疗方法的必要性。多组学策略、基于CRISPR的基因组工程、人工智能和宿主导向疗法的最新进展正在变革精准抗利什曼病药物发现。在本综述中，我们探讨多组学技术如何揭示参与寄生虫生存、毒力和耐药性的通路。我们审视基于CRISPR的技术在功能基因组筛选、靶点验证和耐药机制研究中的贡献。作为这些方法的补充，AI辅助预测建模支持靶点优先级排序、虚拟筛选和结构导向的药物发现。我们还讨论宿主导向免疫疗法作为寄生虫导向疗法的补充策略。特别关注调节氧化还原稳态、甾醇生物合成、MAP激酶信号传导、线粒体电子传递和精氨酸代谢的高优先级治疗通路。总体而言，这些策略提供了一个整合框架，连接靶点发现、功能验证、计算优先级排序和宿主免疫调节，同时支持精准导向的方法，以开发更安全、更高效且抗耐药性的抗利什曼病疗法。

papers.title: Integrative Systems Biology Prioritizes BCL2, ALK, and CDK4 as Therapeutic Candidates in Neuroblastoma through Multi-Centrality Network Analysis, Cross-Database Validation, Independent Docking Validation, and Confidence-Threshold Sensitivity Analysis.
papers.authors: Zabihi, Abbas
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多中心网络分析、对接和MD模拟优先神经母细胞瘤治疗靶点（BCL2、ALK、CDK4），但对象非CRISPR/碱基编辑，机制上仅涉及药物-靶点结合，无核酸酶切割或碱基编辑机制，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Neuroblastoma remains a therapeutic challenge due to its molecular heterogeneity, yet the convergent network topology of its oncogenic interactome has not been systematically characterized using multi-criteria computational approaches. An integrative computational framework combining network-based hub gene prioritization, cross-database biological validation, and structure-based drug-target assessment is needed to identify and prioritize therapeutic molecular targets. METHODS: An integrative computational pipeline was developed comprising (i) batch-effect correction (ComBat) and differential expression analysis of two neuroblastoma microarray datasets (GSE10927, GSE16476); (ii) protein-protein interaction (PPI) network reconstruction (STRING v11.5) and multi-criteria candidate identification using six complementary centrality metrics (degree, betweenness, closeness, MCC, MNC, EPC); (iii) modular decomposition (Louvain algorithm) and functional enrichment analysis (GO, KEGG, WikiPathways); (iv) miRNA regulatory network analysis (DIANA-miRPath/TarBase); (v) independent cross-validation against six external databases (TARGET-NBL, Human Protein Atlas, CCLE, DepMap, GDSC, cBioPortal); (vi) molecular docking (HDOCK) and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations (one trajectory per complex) with trajectory analysis (RMSD, RMSF, Rg, hydrogen-bond occupancy); and (vii) two revision-stage verification analyses: an independent AutoDock Vina re-docking validation of the five drug-target pairs and their co-crystallized ligands, and a confidence-threshold sensitivity analysis of the PPI network (0.400/0.700/0.900) computed on the version-locked STRING v11.5 release restricted to the exported hub node set. RESULTS: The batch-corrected transcriptomic integration effectively separated tumors from normal samples (PCA, 82.9% variance explained). Multi-criteria network analysis prioritized BCL2, ALK, MYCN, CDK4, and MAPT as leading candidates. Modular decomposition revealed seven functional clusters spanning cell cycle regulation, apoptosis, MAPK signaling, and neuronal differentiation. BCL2, ALK, and CDK4 showed multi-database validation concordance: transcriptomic overexpression (TARGET-NBL, log2FC = 1.84 for BCL2, FDR < 0.001), protein-level confirmation (Human Protein Atlas), selective gene dependency (DepMap CRISPR), and pharmacogenomic sensitivity (GDSC). miRNA network analysis identified miR-34a as a master post-transcriptional regulator targeting BCL2, CDK4, and MYCN simultaneously. The original HDOCK docking and 100-ns MD analyses (one trajectory per complex) supported predicted binding stability for BCL2/Venetoclax (HDOCK score: -271.19), ALK/Ceritinib (-222.91), and CDK4/Abemaciclib (-219.76). The revision-stage sensitivity analysis showed that hub-hub connectivity is strongly threshold-dependent (508, 138, and 48 interactions among the exported hub nodes at confidence >/= 0.400, 0.700, and 0.900), and that the centrality of the three priority genes is sensitive to network stringency; they are therefore described as computationally prioritized candidates rather than threshold-robust hubs. The independent Vina validation recovered the native binding sites of all five targets (top-pose centroid offsets 0.15-2.6 A) with favorable scores for every drug-target pair (-12.3 to -6.4 kcal/mol), while pose-level RMSD values (4.8-7.3 A) showed that rigid-receptor docking does not resolve exact ligand orientations for these flexible inhibitors; docking scores are therefore interpreted as site-level binding-competence evidence only. CONCLUSIONS: This study presents an integrative computational pipeline for network-based drug-target prioritization in neuroblastoma, combining multi-criteria network topology, multi-database biological validation, HDOCK docking with single-trajectory MD stability assessment, and two independent revision-stage verification analyses (AutoDock Vina re-docking and confidence-threshold sensitivity). Within the explicitly reported boundaries of these analyses, BCL2, ALK, and CDK4, together with the AURKA and beta-tubulin axes of Alisertib and Docetaxel, emerge as computationally prioritized candidates for preclinical investigation, with replicate MD simulations on high-performance computing resources and experimental target engagement identified as the required next steps.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：神经母细胞瘤因其分子异质性仍是治疗难题，但其致癌相互作用组的汇聚网络拓扑尚未通过多标准计算方法系统表征。需要一种整合计算框架，结合基于网络的枢纽基因优先级排序、跨数据库生物学验证和基于结构的药物-靶点评估，以识别并优先排序治疗性分子靶点。方法：开发了一种整合计算流程，包括（i）批次效应校正（ComBat）和两个神经母细胞瘤微阵列数据集（GSE10927、GSE16476）的差异表达分析；（ii）蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络重建（STRING v11.5）及使用六种互补中心性指标（degree、betweenness、closeness、MCC、MNC、EPC）的多标准候选识别；（iii）模块分解（Louvain算法）和功能富集分析（GO、KEGG、WikiPathways）；（iv）miRNA调控网络分析（DIANA-miRPath/TarBase）；（v）针对六个外部数据库（TARGET-NBL、Human Protein Atlas、CCLE、DepMap、GDSC、cBioPortal）的独立交叉验证；（vi）分子对接（HDOCK）和100-ns分子动力学模拟（每个复合物一条轨迹），并进行轨迹分析（RMSD、RMSF、Rg、氢键占有率）；以及（vii）两个修订阶段验证分析：对五个药物-靶点对及其共结晶配体的独立AutoDock Vina重新对接验证，以及在版本锁定的STRING v11.5版本上、限制于导出的枢纽节点集计算的PPI网络置信度阈值敏感性分析（0.400/0.700/0.900）。结果：批次校正后的转录组整合有效分离了肿瘤与正常样本（PCA，解释82.9%方差）。多标准网络分析将BCL2、ALK、MYCN、CDK4和MAPT优先列为领先候选。模块分解揭示了七个功能簇，涵盖细胞周期调控、凋亡、MAPK信号传导和神经元分化。BCL2、ALK和CDK4显示出多数据库验证一致性：转录组过表达（TARGET-NBL，BCL2的log2FC = 1.84，FDR < 0.001）、蛋白水平确认（Human Protein Atlas）、选择性基因依赖性（DepMap CRISPR）和药物基因组学敏感性（GDSC）。miRNA网络分析识别出miR-34a作为同时靶向BCL2、CDK4和MYCN的主转录后调控因子。原始HDOCK对接和100-ns MD分析（每个复合物一条轨迹）支持BCL2/Venetoclax（HDOCK评分：-271.19）、ALK/Ceritinib（-222.91）和CDK4/Abemaciclib（-219.76）的预测结合稳定性。修订阶段敏感性分析显示，枢纽-枢纽连接性强烈依赖阈值（在置信度≥0.400、0.700和0.900下，导出的枢纽节点间分别有508、138和48个相互作用），且三个优先基因的中心性对网络严格性敏感；因此，它们被描述为计算优先候选，而非阈值稳健枢纽。独立Vina验证恢复了所有五个靶点的天然结合位点（最高姿态质心偏移0.15-2.6 Å），每个药物-靶点对均获得有利评分（-12.3至-6.4 kcal/mol），而姿态级RMSD值（4.8-7.3 Å）表明刚性受体对接无法解析这些柔性抑制剂的精确配体取向；因此，对接评分仅被解释为位点级结合能力证据。结论：本研究提出了一种整合计算流程，用于神经母细胞瘤中基于网络的药物-靶点优先排序，结合多标准网络拓扑、多数据库生物学验证、HDOCK对接与单轨迹MD稳定性评估，以及两个独立修订阶段验证分析（AutoDock Vina重新对接和置信度阈值敏感性）。在这些分析明确报告的边界内，BCL2、ALK和CDK4，连同Alisertib和Docetaxel的AURKA和β-微管蛋白轴，成为计算优先的临床前研究候选，而高性能计算资源上的重复MD模拟和实验性靶点参与被确定为必要的后续步骤。

papers.title: Transposon end recognition and excision mechanisms of type I-F CRISPR-associated transposases.
papers.authors: Walter, Mateusz; Finocchio, Giada; Oberli, Seraina; Hammerschmid, Iana C; Lampe, George D; Karan, Julia; Swartjes, Thomas; Sternberg, Samuel H; Jinek, Martin; Querques, Irma
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和生化重构解析I-F型CRISPR相关转座子TnsAB的转座子末端识别与切除机制，虽对象为转座子而非碱基编辑，但其蛋白-DNA互作、DNA断裂与切割机制对理解CRISPR系统及交错切割机制具有可迁移的启发价值。
papers.abstract: CRISPR-associated transposons (CASTs) are Tn7-like elements that have co-opted RNA-guided CRISPR effectors for targeted DNA insertion. CASTs have been adapted as genome editing tools for programmable, site-specific integration. Among them, the type I-F system from Pseudoalteromonas (PseCAST) shows exceptionally robust activity in human cells, yet its mechanistic basis remains poorly understood. Here, we present structural and biochemical analysis of the PseCAST transposase TnsAB. Biochemical reconstitution of transposon DNA excision defines key characteristics of the transposition mechanism. Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of PseTnsAB paired-end complexes reveal molecular determinants of transpososome assembly, transposon end recognition and cleavage. We validate these findings using biochemical and in vivo assays of structure-based transposase mutants, and provide mechanistic insights into the enhanced activity of a laboratory-evolved TnsAB variant. Together, our studies highlight molecular features underlying the efficiency of natural and engineered type I-F transposases and establish a mechanistic framework for their continued rational optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: CRISPR相关转座子（CASTs）是Tn7样元件，已利用RNA引导的CRISPR效应器实现靶向DNA插入。CASTs已被改造为基因组编辑工具，用于可编程的位点特异性整合。其中，来自假交替单胞菌（Pseudoalteromonas）的I-F型系统（PseCAST）在人类细胞中表现出异常强大的活性，但其机制基础仍知之甚少。在此，我们展示了PseCAST转座酶TnsAB的结构和生化分析。转座子DNA切除的生化重构定义了转座机制的关键特征。PseTnsAB配对末端复合物的冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）结构揭示了转座体组装、转座子末端识别和切割的分子决定因素。我们通过基于结构的转座酶突变体的生化和体内实验验证了这些发现，并为实验室进化TnsAB变体的增强活性提供了机制见解。综合来看，我们的研究突出了天然和工程化I-F型转座酶效率背后的分子特征，并为其持续理性优化建立了机制框架。

papers.title: Targeting snake venom metalloproteinases: structural diversity, molecular pathogenesis and therapeutic interventions.
papers.authors: Dodakallanavar, Jagadeesh; Harish, Darasaguppe R; Hiremath, Kashinath; Sampat, Ganesh H; Patil, Vishal S; Mahadevamurthy, Rashmi K; Ugare, Sanjay; Akula, Kranthi Kiran; Manjunathachar, H V
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦蛇毒金属蛋白酶的结构与治疗干预，仅提及CRISPR作为工具，未涉及碱基编辑或交错切割机制，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: Snake venom Metalloproteinases (SVMPs) are Zn(2)(+)-dependent endopeptidases categorised under metzincin superfamily and are predominantly found in venom of the "Viperidae" family snakes. They are key mediators of venom-induced pathology with associated tissue damage including haemorrhage and oedema. SVMPs are classified as P-I, P-II, and P-III depending on the domains, each differing in structural complexity and organization. Further, the conserved HEXXHXXGXXH catalytic motif organizes a Zn(2+) ion, essential for the breakdown of peptide bonds and proteins. Given the limitations of conventional antivenom therapy, increasing attention has been directed toward targeted approaches for SVMPs neutralization, including plant-derived phytocompounds, synthetic and repurposed small-molecule inhibitors, recombinant monoclonal antibodies, and camelid-derived nanobodies. Structure-based drug discovery, molecular docking, and mechanistic studies have facilitated the identification of compounds and biologics capable of interfering with SVMP catalytic activity, substrate recognition or functionally relevant epitopes. Emerging technologies such as CRISPR-engineered venom gland organoids and artificial intelligence/machine learning-assisted molecular screening further provide opportunities for functional target validation and rational therapeutic discovery. This review integrates these conventional and emerging strategies, highlighting the structural basis of SVMPs inhibition and their potential to support the development of precise, broad-spectrum, and next-generation therapeutic interventions against SVMP-mediated envenoming.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛇毒金属蛋白酶（SVMPs）是依赖Zn(2)(+)的肽链内切酶，归类于metzincin超家族，主要存在于“蝰蛇科”（Viperidae）蛇类的毒液中。它们是蛇毒诱导病理过程的关键介质，伴随组织损伤，包括出血和水肿。SVMPs根据结构域分为P-I、P-II和P-III三类，每类在结构复杂性和组织方式上各有不同。此外，保守的HEXXHXXGXXH催化基序组织一个Zn(2+)离子，对肽键和蛋白质的分解至关重要。鉴于传统抗蛇毒血清疗法的局限性，越来越多的关注已转向针对SVMPs中和的靶向方法，包括植物来源的植物化合物、合成和再利用的小分子抑制剂、重组单克隆抗体以及骆驼科动物来源的纳米抗体。基于结构的药物发现、分子对接和机制研究促进了能够干扰SVMP催化活性、底物识别或功能相关表位的化合物和生物制剂的识别。新兴技术如CRISPR工程化毒腺类器官和人工智能/机器学习辅助分子筛选，进一步为功能靶点验证和理性治疗发现提供了机会。本综述整合了这些传统和新兴策略，强调了SVMPs抑制的结构基础及其支持开发针对SVMP介导中毒的精准、广谱和下一代治疗干预措施的潜力。

papers.title: Structural insights into target detection by the Serratia type III CRISPR complex and its deployment in SNP identification.
papers.authors: Perdigao, Calvin C; Ajisafe, Luqman O; Sunny, Anju T; Wu, Si; Dokland, Terje; Dunkle, Jack A
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究解析了Serratia III型CRISPR-Cas10-Csm复合物靶标识别与cA3合成的结构机制，并利用其SNP检测能力，虽非碱基编辑/交错切割，但Cas-crRNA-靶标互作与构象变化机制对本课题有可迁移启发。
papers.abstract: Type III CRISPR systems utilize a complex containing Cas10, additional Cas proteins and a crRNA to detect foreign transcripts. Upon detection, Cas10 synthesizes cyclic oligoadenylates (cOA), signaling molecules that coordinate interference by stimulating downstream enzymes with DNase, RNase, protease or other activities. Type III systems possess properties well-suited to their deployment as molecular diagnostics: specific detection and activation of a cascade of multi-turnover enzymatic reactions that can be harnessed for signal generation. We answered key questions concerning the structure and function of Serratia Cas10-Csm to facilitate its use in molecular diagnostics. We determined that Serratia Cas10-Csm (SerrCas10-Csm) synthesizes predominantly cA(3) molecules and this synthesis is sensitive to mismatches in the crRNA-target RNA duplex adjacent to Cas10. To understand how Cas10 senses the presence of a bound target RNA, we determined the structure of SerrCas10-Csm unbound and bound to target RNA identifying conformational changes associated with target binding. We programmed SerrCas10-Csm with a crRNA recognizing a single nucleotide polymorphism that occurs in the human HBB transcript and is associated with sickle cell disease. We demonstrate that when the polymorphism occurs in the +1 position of the crRNA-target duplex, SerrCas10-Csm can distinguish it indicating an additional role for type III CRISPR systems in point-of-care diagnostics in low-resource settings.
papers.abstract_zh: III型CRISPR系统利用包含Cas10、其他Cas蛋白及crRNA的复合物来检测外来转录本。检测到后，Cas10合成环状寡腺苷酸（cOA），这些信号分子通过刺激具有DNase、RNase、蛋白酶或其他活性的下游酶来协调干扰作用。III型系统具备适合部署为分子诊断工具的特性：特异性检测并激活一系列多轮酶促反应，这些反应可用于信号生成。我们解答了关于粘质沙雷氏菌Cas10-Csm结构和功能的关键问题，以促进其在分子诊断中的应用。我们确定粘质沙雷氏菌Cas10-Csm（SerrCas10-Csm）主要合成cA(3)分子，且此合成对crRNA-靶RNA双链体中邻近Cas10的错配敏感。为理解Cas10如何感知结合靶RNA的存在，我们解析了SerrCas10-Csm未结合和结合靶RNA的结构，识别出与靶标结合相关的构象变化。我们用识别人类HBB转录本中与镰状细胞病相关的单核苷酸多态性的crRNA对SerrCas10-Csm进行编程。我们证明，当该多态性出现在crRNA-靶标双链体的+1位置时，SerrCas10-Csm能区分它，这表明III型CRISPR系统在资源匮乏环境下的即时诊断中具有额外作用。

papers.title: Genetic vulnerability and dynamic mechanical stress synergistically drive sarcomere failure in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes.
papers.authors: Wang, Chenyan; Mai, Nhu Y; Donelson, Fred J; Moradi Nasab, Susan; Shi, Huaiyu; Yang, Huaxiao; Mather, Patrick T; Wang, Xinrui; Henderson, James H; Ma, Zhen
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CRISPR/Cas9工程化心肌细胞研究机械应力与基因突变对肌节功能的影响，但核心对象是心肌细胞力学表型而非CRISPR/碱基编辑机制，仅将CRISPR作为基因编辑工具，无切割或编辑机制研究，与本课题关联度低。
papers.abstract: Mechanical stress plays a critical role in regulating cardiomyocyte structure and physiology. However, mechanobiology studies still rely on static systems that failed to capture the progressive nature of native cardiac remodeling. Building on our prior shape memory polymer (SMP)-based platform, the present study integrates microcontact printing onto SMP substrates to achieve single-cell geometric control and on-demand dynamic mechanical modulation. Using CRISPR/Cas9-engineered MYBPC3- and BAG3-mutant hiPSC-CMs along with isogenic wild-type (WT) control, we systematically assessed sarcomere organization and contractile behavior under static and dynamic mechanical conditions. WT hiPSC-CMs displayed robust morphological adaptability and coordinated sarcomere remodeling in response to dynamic mechanical cues, whereas MYBPC3- and BAG3-deficient hiPSC-CMs exhibited mutation-specific defects in sarcomere integrity and contractile behavior that were exacerbated by dynamic mechanical stress. These results demonstrate that this SMP-based platform enables us to systematically compare genotype-based mechanical sensitivity to develop more severe cardiomyopathy phenotypes.
papers.abstract_zh: 机械应力在调控心肌细胞结构与生理功能中发挥关键作用。然而，力学生物学研究仍依赖于静态系统，未能捕捉天然心脏重塑的渐进性特征。基于我们先前基于形状记忆聚合物 (shape memory polymer, SMP) 的平台，本研究将微接触印刷整合至SMP基底上，以实现单细胞几何控制及按需动态机械调节。利用CRISPR/Cas9工程化的MYBPC3-和BAG3突变型hiPSC-CMs，以及同基因野生型 (wild-type, WT) 对照，我们系统评估了在静态和动态机械条件下的肌节组织与收缩行为。WT hiPSC-CMs在响应动态机械信号时表现出稳健的形态适应性和协调的肌节重塑，而MYBPC3-和BAG3缺陷型hiPSC-CMs则表现出突变特异性的肌节完整性和收缩行为缺陷，且这些缺陷在动态机械应力下加剧。这些结果表明，该基于SMP的平台使我们能够系统比较基因型相关的机械敏感性，以开发更严重的心肌病表型。

papers.title: Bacteriophage-bacteria coevolution: from molecular arms races to ecological and applied perspectives.
papers.authors: Shang, Junjie; Li, Linghui; Dong, Chengqian; Wei, Yunlin
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述噬菌体-细菌共进化中的防御与反防御机制，涵盖CRISPR-Cas系统，但侧重生态与应用，缺乏对切割/碱基编辑分子机制的深入分析。
papers.abstract: Bacteriophages are the most abundant biological entities, driving bacterial evolution through long-term coevolution. Bacteria have evolved diverse defense strategies against phage, including receptor modification, restriction-modification systems, CRISPR-Cas, abortive infection systems, and newly discovered systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, Thoeris, and Zorya. In response, phages deploy countermeasures such as receptor-binding diversification, anti-CRISPR proteins, DNA modification, and inhibitors targeting host immunity. These interactions generate distinct evolutionary dynamics-arms race and fluctuating selection-shaping microbial population structure and ecological stability. Phage-host coevolution promotes microbial diversity, horizontal gene transfer, and regulates community composition across ecosystems. Understanding these processes is critical for applications like phage therapy, microbiome engineering, and biotechnology. This review summarizes molecular mechanisms of bacterial defense and phage counter-defense, discusses coevolutionary models, highlights ecological and applied implications, and outlines future research directions.
papers.abstract_zh: 噬菌体是最丰富的生物实体，通过长期共进化驱动细菌的进化。细菌已进化出多种针对噬菌体的防御策略，包括受体修饰、限制-修饰系统、CRISPR-Cas、流产感染系统，以及新发现的系统如BREX、DISARM、CBASS、Thoeris和Zorya。作为回应，噬菌体部署反制措施，如受体结合多样化、抗CRISPR蛋白、DNA修饰以及靶向宿主免疫的抑制剂。这些相互作用产生不同的进化动态——军备竞赛和波动选择——塑造微生物种群结构和生态稳定性。噬菌体-宿主共进化促进微生物多样性、水平基因转移，并调节各生态系统中的群落组成。理解这些过程对于噬菌体疗法、微生物组工程和生物技术等应用至关重要。本综述总结了细菌防御和噬菌体反防御的分子机制，讨论了共进化模型，强调了生态和应用意义，并概述了未来研究方向。

papers.title: Genomic imprinting of the metabolic regulator gene Klf14 is regulated by a paternal sub-TAD anchored at Mest.
papers.authors: Ha, Amanda; Hayashi, Natsuki; Bogutz, Aaron B; Moindrot, Benoit; Gomez, Laura; Harris, Juliette; Marcil, Alexandre; Court, Frank; Shindo, Miyuki; Arnaud, Philippe; Drouin, Jacques; Forne, Thierry; Noordermeer, Daan; Takada, Shuji; Nakabayashi, Kazuhiko; Lefebvre, Louis
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究Klf14基因印记的父源亚TAD调控机制，虽使用CRISPR-Cas9删除但聚焦基因组印记与染色质结构，未涉及碱基编辑或交错切割机制，与本课题核心方向关联较弱。
papers.abstract: KLF14 acts as a master regulator of gene expression in adipose tissue and variants at the human KLF14 gene show reproducible association with type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome. Risk alleles are only pathological when maternally inherited, consistent with the observation that KLF14/Klf14 is a maternally expressed imprinted gene in human and mouse. However, how genomic imprinting is regulated at this important locus is currently unknown. In both species, KLF14/Klf14 is located  approximately 200 kb away from the paternally expressed imprinted gene MEST/Mest, regulated by a maternal gametic differentially methylated region (gDMR) at its promoter. Although the Klf14 promoter is unmethylated in most tissues, maternally inherited DNA methylation marks are paradoxically required for Klf14 expression. Here, we show that Mest and Klf14 reside within the same topologically associating domain (TAD) in embryonic stem cells (ESCs), defined by biallelic CTCF binding at the boundaries. Using allele-specific 4C-seq, we show that CTCF binding to the unmethylated Mest gDMR generates a paternal allele-specific sub-TAD encompassing Klf14 CRISPR-Cas9 deletions of the paternal Mest promoter region in ESCs and in vivo in mutant mice result in loss of Mest expression and acquisition of biallelic expression at Klf14 By analyzing epigenetic marks and chromatin looping in Klf14-expressing pituitary cells, we identify a putative enhancer element shared by Mest and Klf14, providing a mechanistic model for the regulation of Klf14 imprinting. This work defines a new role for the Mest maternally methylated gDMR, revealing that it exerts long-range effects via allele-specific modulation of TAD structures and acts as an imprinting control region in the regulation of Klf14 imprinting.
papers.abstract_zh: KLF14在脂肪组织中充当基因表达的主调控因子，人类KLF14基因的变异与2型糖尿病和代谢综合征表现出可重复的关联。风险等位基因仅在母源遗传时具有致病性，这与KLF14/Klf14在人类和小鼠中作为母源表达印记基因的观察结果一致。然而，目前尚不清楚基因组印记如何在这个重要位点被调控。在两个物种中，KLF14/Klf14位于父源表达印记基因MEST/Mest约200 kb处，后者由其启动子处的母源配子差异甲基化区域（gDMR）调控。尽管Klf14启动子在大多数组织中未甲基化，但母源遗传的DNA甲基化标记却矛盾地是Klf14表达所必需的。在此，我们显示Mest和Klf14在胚胎干细胞（ESCs）中位于同一拓扑关联结构域（TAD）内，该结构域由边界处的双等位CTCF结合定义。利用等位基因特异性4C-seq，我们表明CTCF结合到未甲基化的Mest gDMR上，产生一个父源等位基因特异性的亚TAD，涵盖Klf14。在ESCs中及体内突变小鼠中，通过CRISPR-Cas9删除父源Mest启动子区域，导致Mest表达丧失并在Klf14处获得双等位表达。通过分析Klf14表达垂体细胞中的表观遗传标记和染色质环化，我们识别出一个Mest和Klf14共有的推定增强子元件，为Klf14印记调控提供了机制模型。这项工作定义了Mest母源甲基化gDMR的新角色，揭示其通过等位基因特异性调节TAD结构发挥长程效应，并在Klf14印记调控中充当印记控制区域。

papers.title: Structure-guided discovery and engineering of miniature CRISPR-Cas12m for epigenome editing.
papers.authors: Yu, Tao; Ji, Meng; Yu, Donglin; Guan, Zhao; Zhu, Rongyi; Jiang, Yunpeng; Yang, Zhiyi; Qiu, Lizhen; Zhang, Ziyi; Mu, Jiawei; Mao, Fengbiao; Xiang, Kuanhui; Bai, Lin; Li, Kailong
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构引导发现并工程化微型CRISPR-Cas12m，用于表观基因组编辑，虽无切割活性但深入解析了其DNA结合机制，与碱基编辑/交错切割机制部分相关。
papers.abstract: CRISPR-based epigenome editing represents a programmable strategy to precisely modulate gene expression, holding promise for therapeutic applications. However, the large size of dCas proteins substantially impedes delivery using adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors. Here, through iterative bioinformatics analysis, structure-guided predictions and functional assays, we identified and characterized a miniature subtype V-M CRISPR-Cas12m from Pelomicrobium methylotrophicum. PmCas12m exhibited flexible 5'-YTN-3' PAM-dependent recognition and robust double-stranded DNA-binding properties while lacking DNA cleavage activity, thus rendering it a valuable tool for epigenome editing. Cryo-electron microscopy structures of PmCas12m unveiled its molecular mechanism of target DNA binding. Guided by these structural insights, we used deep mutational scanning and protein engineering to develop xCas12m, a hypercompact variant with highly potent and specific epigenome-editing capabilities in human cells. We further constructed the xCas12m-CRISPRoff platform in a single AAV vector, which achieved durable epigenetic silencing and effective inhibition of hepatitis B virus infection in a mouse model. Collectively, these findings establish xCas12m as a versatile epigenome-editing platform with notable potential for treating diseases, paving the way for clinical translation of epigenetic therapies.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于CRISPR的表观基因组编辑代表了一种可编程策略，能够精确调控基因表达，在治疗应用中展现出前景。然而，dCas蛋白的大尺寸显著阻碍了使用腺相关病毒（AAV）载体的递送。在此，通过迭代生物信息学分析、结构引导预测和功能检测，我们从甲基营养型佩洛微菌（Pelomicrobium methylotrophicum）中鉴定并表征了一种微型V-M亚型CRISPR-Cas12m。PmCas12m表现出灵活的5'-YTN-3' PAM依赖性识别和强大的双链DNA结合特性，同时缺乏DNA切割活性，因此使其成为表观基因组编辑的有价值工具。PmCas12m的冷冻电镜结构揭示了其靶DNA结合的分子机制。在这些结构见解的指导下，我们利用深度突变扫描和蛋白质工程开发了xCas12m，这是一种超紧凑变体，在人类细胞中具有高效且特异的表观基因组编辑能力。我们进一步在单AAV载体中构建了xCas12m-CRISPRoff平台，在小鼠模型中实现了持久的表观遗传沉默和乙型肝炎病毒感染的有效抑制。总体而言，这些发现确立了xCas12m作为一种多功能表观基因组编辑平台，在治疗疾病方面具有显著潜力，为表观遗传疗法的临床转化铺平了道路。

papers.title: Tumor FAK supports fibrillar collagen expression in ovarian cancer ascites.
papers.authors: Ojalill, Marjaana; Haanen, Terrance J 3rd; Khan, Safir Ullah; Zhang, Yichi; Boyer, Antonia; Chen, Xiao Lei; Suwal, Ujjwal; Rappu, Pekka; Heino, Jyrki; McHale, Michael T; Stupack, Dwayne G; Schlaepfer, David D
papers.journal: Matrix biology : journal of the International Society for Matrix Biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨卵巢癌中FAK调控胶原蛋白表达，仅用CRISPR作为基因敲除工具，不涉及切割机制或碱基编辑，与本课题核心无关。
papers.abstract: High-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) is a lethal malignancy where matrix proteins enhance ascites-associated recurrent tumor growth. Elevated focal adhesion kinase (FAK/PTK2) and collagen protein expression support tumor survival, chemoresistance, and immune evasion. However, the sources and regulation of collagen production within HGSOC tumorspheres is unclear. Using CRISPR-mediated FAK knockout and FAK re-expression in two syngeneic HGSOC models (MOVCAR and KMF), FAK loss impaired tumorsphere growth in vitro and in vivo while reducing collagen expression, as determined by RNA sequencing, quantitative RT-PCR, and protein mass spectrometry. FAK re-expression promoted spontaneous metastatic ovarian tumor dissemination. Integrated bioinformatic analyses of MOVCAR, KMF, and HGSOC patient datasets identified 56 common mRNAs co-elevated with PTK2, including COL3A1 and COL5A2. Single-cell RNA sequencing of murine KMF ascites revealed a subset of tumor cells expressing Col3a1 and Col5a2 that exhibited epithelial-to-mesenchymal pathway enrichment that was diminished by genetic or pharmacologic FAK inhibition. In primary HGSOC ascites samples, FAK inhibitor (IN10018 or VS-4718) or FAK protein degrader (PROTAC) treatment selectively reduced COL1A1, COL3A1, and COL5A2 mRNA levels in tumor cells. Further, human OVCAR8 spheroid COL1A1, COL3A1, and COL5A2 mRNA and spheroid structure were significantly impacted by FAK inhibition and blocking anti-alpha1 or anti-beta1 integrin antibodies. As elevated PTK2 and COL3A1 expression correlate with poor ovarian cancer patient survival, and FAK, alpha1, and beta1 integrin inhibition reduced spheroid COL3A1 protein levels, our findings support a feed-forward linkage whereby FAK regulates fibrillar collagen acting in part via collagen binding integrins supporting HGSOC tumorsphere survival and metastatic spread.
papers.abstract_zh: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSOC）是一种致命性恶性肿瘤，其中基质蛋白增强腹水相关的复发性肿瘤生长。升高的黏着斑激酶（FAK/PTK2）和胶原蛋白表达支持肿瘤存活、化疗耐药和免疫逃逸。然而，HGSOC肿瘤球内胶原蛋白产生的来源和调控尚不清楚。通过在两个同基因HGSOC模型（MOVCAR和KMF）中使用CRISPR介导的FAK敲除和FAK重新表达，FAK缺失损害了体外和体内的肿瘤球生长，同时降低了胶原蛋白表达，这通过RNA测序、定量RT-PCR和蛋白质质谱法确定。FAK重新表达促进了自发性转移性卵巢肿瘤播散。对MOVCAR、KMF和HGSOC患者数据集的整合生物信息学分析识别出56个与PTK2共同升高的常见mRNA，包括COL3A1和COL5A2。小鼠KMF腹水的单细胞RNA测序揭示了一组表达Col3a1和Col5a2的肿瘤细胞，这些细胞表现出上皮-间质转化通路富集，而这种富集通过遗传或药理学FAK抑制而减弱。在原代HGSOC腹水样本中，FAK抑制剂（IN10018或VS-4718）或FAK蛋白降解剂（PROTAC）处理选择性地降低了肿瘤细胞中COL1A1、COL3A1和COL5A2 mRNA水平。此外，人OVCAR8球体的COL1A1、COL3A1和COL5A2 mRNA及球体结构受到FAK抑制和阻断抗α1或抗β1整合素抗体的显著影响。由于升高的PTK2和COL3A1表达与卵巢癌患者较差生存率相关，且FAK、α1和β1整合素抑制降低了球体COL3A1蛋白水平，我们的发现支持一个前馈连接机制，即FAK通过部分依赖胶原结合整合素调节纤维状胶原蛋白，从而支持HGSOC肿瘤球存活和转移扩散。

papers.title: Target, silence, replace: a review on RNA-based drugs in modern medicine.
papers.authors: Mundlia, Poonam; Singh, Suraj Pratap; Pothal, Pritiman; Thakur, Tanya; Kathuria, Reema; Maurya, Sudhanshu; Sharma, Akanksha; Goel, Honey; Pandey, Ankur; Ranawat, Pavitra; Singh, Gurpal; Barnwal, Ravi Pratap
papers.journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述RNA药物（siRNA、mRNA、ASO等）的作用机制与递送策略，仅简要提及CRISPR基因组编辑，未涉及stagger-cleavage或碱基编辑的分子机制，与本课题关联度低。
papers.abstract: RNA therapies have evolved into a revolutionary approach in contemporary medicine for treating various diseases by directly targeting RNA molecules engaged in disease pathogenesis. These therapeutic agents regulate biological processes through diverse mechanisms, including modulation of RNA function and gene expression. Medical applications of RNA are greatly enhanced by its structure, adaptability, and capacity for targeted binding. Among these traits is its ability to bind to certain molecules unique to those chemicals. RNA-based treatments have emerged from advancements in the production, modification, and cellular transport of RNA molecules. Several RNA drugs have been approved whereas some are under trial for few diseases. RNA therapeutics can function at the level of RNAs, DNAs and proteins. The evolution of mRNA vaccines during the COVID-19 epidemic emphasizes the exciting potential of RNA therapies in the treatment of diseases. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the several forms of RNA therapies, including small-interfering RNA (siRNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), and antisense-oligonucleotides (ASOs), together with information on their action mechanisms and delivery strategies that improve cellular absorption and shield RNA molecules from degradation. Further, CRISPR-based editing of the genome can be employed for modification of target RNA sequences for various disorders. Development of RNA aptamers have also been identified as pivotal RNA-therapeutic candidate. Additionally, we have explained mechanistic details and examples of drugs approved for RNA therapy. Emphasizing their potential to enhance patient outcomes and fulfil unmet medical requirements, we also highlight the clinical development of RNA therapies in treating cancer and other infectious diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: RNA疗法已发展成为当代医学中一种革命性的方法，通过直接靶向参与疾病发病机制的RNA分子来治疗多种疾病。这些治疗药物通过多种机制调节生物过程，包括调控RNA功能和基因表达。RNA的医学应用因其结构、适应性及靶向结合能力而大大增强。在这些特性中，包括其与某些化学物质特有的分子结合的能力。基于RNA的治疗方法源于RNA分子的生产、修饰和细胞转运方面的进展。已有几种RNA药物获批，而一些正在针对少数疾病进行试验。RNA疗法可在RNA、DNA和蛋白质水平发挥作用。COVID-19疫情期间mRNA疫苗的发展凸显了RNA疗法在疾病治疗中的巨大潜力。本文全面概述了多种形式的RNA疗法，包括小干扰RNA（siRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和反义寡核苷酸（ASOs），并提供了其作用机制及递送策略的信息，这些策略可改善细胞吸收并保护RNA分子免受降解。此外，基于CRISPR的基因组编辑可用于针对各种疾病修饰目标RNA序列。RNA适配体的开发也被确定为关键的RNA治疗候选方案。我们还详细解释了RNA疗法获批药物的机制细节和实例。强调其改善患者预后和满足未竟医疗需求的潜力，我们也重点介绍了RNA疗法在治疗癌症和其他感染性疾病中的临床发展。

papers.title: TANGO1L Is Required for Collagen Secretion in a Type-Dependent Manner and Shapes Collagen Proteostasis in the Endoplasmic Reticulum.
papers.authors: Ishikawa, Yoshihiro; Maeda, Miharu; Taga, Yuki; Komatsu, Yukie; Mizuno, Kazunori; Saito, Kota
papers.journal: Matrix biology : journal of the International Society for Matrix Biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CRISPR/Cas9敲除TANGO1L研究胶原蛋白分泌与内质网稳态，仅将CRISPR作为基因编辑工具，未涉及切割机制或碱基编辑，与本课题核心无关。
papers.abstract: Collagens are synthesized in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), where their biosynthesis, quality control, and secretion are tightly coordinated to maintain collagen proteostasis. TANGO1L is an ER exit site protein required for efficient collagen secretion; however, whether it contributes equally to the secretion and intracellular homeostasis of different collagen types remains unclear. Here, we systematically examined the consequences of TANGO1L deficiency using CRISPR/Cas9-generated TANGO1L knockout human fibroblasts. Loss of TANGO1L reduced the secretion of multiple major collagen types and delayed secretion of newly synthesized collagen I. Intracellular responses, however, differed markedly among collagen types: collagen V accumulated intracellularly, whereas collagens I, III, and IV avoided intracellular retention despite markedly reduced extracellular secretion. This differential response was accompanied by decreased collagen gene expression and selective remodeling of the ER collagen biosynthetic machinery, suggesting that these cells adjust collagen synthesis to a reduced secretory capacity. TANGO1S protein was consistently upregulated through a post-transcriptional mechanism, suggesting an adaptive response to chronic TANGO1L deficiency. Biochemical analysis of collagen purified from the culture medium revealed a trend toward modestly increased lysine post-translational modifications, including hydroxylysine glycosylation, without altered triple-helical structure or thermal stability, indicating that TANGO1L deficiency compromises the quantity rather than the quality of secreted collagen. Together, these findings establish that the requirement for TANGO1L differs among collagen types and that its loss induces adaptive remodeling of intracellular collagen proteostasis rather than simply impairing collagen secretion, providing a framework for understanding how secretory cells maintain collagen homeostasis when secretion is compromised.
papers.abstract_zh: 胶原蛋白在内质网（endoplasmic reticulum, ER）中合成，其生物合成、质量控制及分泌过程被紧密协调以维持胶原蛋白的蛋白质稳态。TANGO1L 是内质网出口位点蛋白，对于高效胶原蛋白分泌至关重要；然而，它是否对不同类型胶原蛋白的分泌及细胞内稳态具有同等贡献仍不清楚。在此，我们利用 CRISPR/Cas9 生成的 TANGO1L 敲除人成纤维细胞，系统研究了 TANGO1L 缺失的后果。TANGO1L 的缺失减少了多种主要类型胶原蛋白的分泌，并延迟了新合成胶原蛋白 I 的分泌。然而，细胞内反应在不同胶原类型间差异显著：胶原蛋白 V 在细胞内积累，而胶原蛋白 I、III 和 IV 尽管细胞外分泌显著减少，却避免了细胞内滞留。这种差异性反应伴随着胶原蛋白基因表达的降低以及内质网胶原蛋白生物合成机制的选择性重塑，表明这些细胞将胶原蛋白合成调整至降低的分泌能力。TANGO1S 蛋白通过一种转录后机制持续上调，提示这是对慢性 TANGO1L 缺失的适应性反应。对从培养基中纯化的胶原蛋白进行的生化分析显示，赖氨酸翻译后修饰（包括羟赖氨酸糖基化）呈适度增加趋势，而三螺旋结构或热稳定性未发生改变，表明 TANGO1L 缺失损害的是分泌胶原蛋白的数量而非质量。综合来看，这些发现确立了 TANGO1L 的需求在不同胶原类型间存在差异，且其缺失诱导细胞内胶原蛋白稳态的适应性重塑，而非简单损害胶原蛋白分泌，为理解分泌细胞在分泌受损时如何维持胶原蛋白稳态提供了框架。

papers.title: Advancements of mRNA-lipid nanoparticle links to gene editing and immune responses.
papers.authors: Sundaram, Karthikeyan; Prabhu, Venkataraman
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒在基因编辑和免疫应答中的应用，涉及CRISPR-Cas9递送效率，但缺乏对切割/碱基编辑分子机制的研究，仅属工具应用层面。
papers.abstract: Lipid-formulated liposomes have been utilized for the transport of various biological substances, including mRNA molecules. Basically, large lipids play a crucial role in the structure and function of cell membranes. In protein synthesis, mRNA plays a crucial role in expressing the proteins. In this context, this natural process enables gene editing, protein replacement therapy, cancer immunotherapy, cellular reprogramming, and vaccinations. A range of biomaterials is utilized for mRNA transport, including polymers, lipid-based nanoparticles, and protein-mRNA complexes. Thus, the review aims to analyse the mRNA-lipid nanoparticles assigned with gene editing and the mechanisms to enhance immune responses to infectious diseases. A nonviral lipid nanoparticle approach for CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing has achieved up to 80% gene editing in vivo and 98% in vitro across various cancer cell types. MEVPCS-mRNA LNPs, as a preventative HIV vaccine, elicit comparable and highly specific immune responses via CD8+ T cells. Th1-type CD4+ T cell responses are notable in mice immunized with LNP-mRNA, indicating a substantial impact on Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Variations in pH, ionic strength, and freezing rate are essential for enhancing the lyophilization of mRNA lipid nanoparticles. The polydispersity index has risen from 0.1 to 0.3, and the LNP particle size in the Vibrating Membrane Nebulizer has increased from an average of 85 nm to 300 nm, suggesting notable structural degradation due to elevated shear stresses. The Laminar Fluid Ejection Device enhanced the stability of lipid nanoparticles. This enhances the immune response and effectively manages harmful microbes.
papers.abstract_zh: 脂质配制的脂质体已被用于运输多种生物物质，包括mRNA分子。基本上，大脂质在细胞膜的结构和功能中起着关键作用。在蛋白质合成中，mRNA在表达蛋白质方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在此背景下，这一自然过程使得基因编辑、蛋白质替代疗法、癌症免疫疗法、细胞重编程和疫苗接种成为可能。多种生物材料被用于mRNA运输，包括聚合物、基于脂质的纳米颗粒和蛋白质-mRNA复合物。因此，本综述旨在分析用于基因编辑的mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒及其增强对传染病免疫应答的机制。一种用于CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑的非病毒脂质纳米颗粒方法，在多种癌细胞类型中，体内基因编辑效率高达80%，体外达98%。MEVPCS-mRNA LNPs作为预防性HIV疫苗，通过CD8+ T细胞引发可比且高度特异性的免疫应答。在LNP-mRNA免疫的小鼠中，Th1型CD4+ T细胞应答显著，表明对结核分枝杆菌具有实质性影响。pH、离子强度和冷冻速率的变化对于增强mRNA脂质纳米颗粒的冻干过程至关重要。多分散指数从0.1升至0.3，振动膜雾化器中LNP颗粒尺寸从平均85 nm增至300 nm，表明由于高剪切应力导致显著的结构降解。层流喷射装置增强了脂质纳米颗粒的稳定性。这增强了免疫应答并有效管理有害微生物。

papers.title: Functional divergence of two soybean cytosolic serine hydroxymethyltransferases in development and defense against soybean cyst nematode.
papers.authors: Gamage, Vinavi A; Owuocha, Luckio F; Lin, Feng; Li, Zenglu; Beamer, Lesa J; Mitchum, Melissa G
papers.one_liner_zh: 研究大豆胞质丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶在发育和抗线虫中的功能分化，不涉及无序蛋白、PPI机制建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Serine hydroxymethyltransferase (SHMT) is an enzyme essential for one-carbon metabolism. In higher plants, multiple SHMT genes code for isoforms that function in the cytosol, nucleus, mitochondria, and chloroplasts. The soybean genome contains two cytosolic SHMTs, GmSHMT05 and GmSHMT08, sharing high sequence identity and similar expression throughout soybean development. In certain soybean genotypes, two amino acid substitutions negatively impact GmSHMT08's ability to bind to tetrahydrofolate (THF), leading to a gain-of-function in resistance to the soybean cyst nematode (SCN). Whether this perturbation to the enzyme has other functional consequences for soybean growth and development remains unknown. Here, we investigated the roles of cytosolic GmSHMTs in soybean growth and development. We determined that the 3D structure and folate-binding affinity of GmSHMT05 are highly similar to the version of GmSHMT08 found in susceptible soybeans. We further measured phenotypic traits of two ethyl methanesulfonate-derived Gmshmt08 mutant plants in an SCN-resistant soybean background. Aboveground soybean growth and development were similar, except the Gmshmt08 mutant plants showed a significant increase in pods/plant in field phenotyping trials. Belowground analyses revealed a significant increase in lateral root and total root length in mutant plants, and CRISPR-Cas9 editing demonstrated an essential role of cytosolic SHMTs in root growth. Taken together, our results indicate that GmSHMT05 sustains overall soybean growth and development in the absence of GmSHMT08; however, GmSHMT08's gain-of-function in SCN resistance negatively influences pod and root growth, highlighting a potential trade-off between soybean defense and development that may impact yield when breeding with GmSHMT08 to develop SCN-resistant varieties.
papers.abstract_zh: 丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶（SHMT）是单碳代谢所必需的酶。在高等植物中，多个SHMT基因编码在细胞质、细胞核、线粒体和叶绿体中发挥作用的同工酶。大豆基因组包含两种胞质SHMT，即GmSHMT05和GmSHMT08，它们具有高度序列同一性，并在大豆整个发育过程中表现出相似的表达模式。在某些大豆基因型中，两个氨基酸替换对GmSHMT08结合四氢叶酸（THF）的能力产生负面影响，导致对大豆胞囊线虫（SCN）抗性的功能获得。这种对酶的扰动是否对大豆生长发育产生其他功能影响仍属未知。在此，我们研究了胞质GmSHMT在大豆生长发育中的作用。我们确定GmSHMT05的三维结构和叶酸结合亲和力与易感大豆中发现的GmSHMT08版本高度相似。我们进一步测量了在抗SCN大豆背景下两种由甲磺酸乙酯诱导的Gmshmt08突变体植株的表型性状。地上部分大豆生长和发育相似，但Gmshmt08突变体植株在田间表型试验中表现出每株荚数的显著增加。地下部分分析显示，突变体植株的侧根和总根长显著增加，CRISPR-Cas9编辑证明胞质SHMT在根生长中具有关键作用。综合来看，我们的结果表明，在缺乏GmSHMT08的情况下，GmSHMT05维持大豆整体生长发育；然而，GmSHMT08在SCN抗性中的功能获得对荚和根生长产生负面影响，这突显了大豆防御与发育之间的潜在权衡，可能在使用GmSHMT08培育抗SCN品种时影响产量。

papers.title: 4D nucleome landscape reveals dissolution of bipartite active X chromosome in liver cancer development.
papers.authors: Xie, Xiaoli; Tan, Delin; Mo, Jingyun; Xu, Yang; Ni, Qingqiang; Liu, Ting; Wang, Huaiming; Chen, Bingjie; Liao, Yujia; Lin, Yingnan; Chen, Wanting; Luo, Susu; Fang, Qing; Zhao, Menglan; Yu, Yangyinhui; Zheng, Cunjing; Cui, Ruolin; Wang, Jiaying; Chang, Hong; Gong, Qing; Cheng, Alfred Sze-Lok; Jiang, Huiqing; Li, Tingting; Wang, Jia
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝癌中X染色体的三维结构变化，不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Changes of three-dimensional chromosome organization in cancers are well established, but little focus has been placed on the behaviour of X chromosome (chrX). Here we show that hepatic chrX of male mice exhibits chromosome segregation, which is attenuated during hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development. Using F1 hybrid mice, we find that both conformation change and gene activation on male active chrX (Xa) are more pronounced than those on female Xa, which is correlated with male bias in liver diseases. Of note, analysis of human hepatic tissues demonstrates that normal Xa possesses a bipartite mega-domain structure, which is dissolved in fibrotic and HCC tissues across both sexes. This bipartite Xa is liver-specific, and shows little correlation with ploidy status. Furthermore, deletion of the megabase-scale Xa boundary via CRISPR-Cas3 disrupts the bipartite Xa conformation and drives a premalignant transition. Together, this comprehensive analysis highlights a key role of Xa conformation change in promoting HCC development.
papers.abstract_zh: 癌症中三维染色体组织的变化已得到充分证实，但关于X染色体（chrX）行为的研究却很少。我们在此发现，雄性小鼠的肝脏chrX表现出染色体分离现象，该现象在肝细胞癌（HCC）发展过程中减弱。利用F1杂交小鼠，我们发现雄性活性X染色体（Xa）的构象变化和基因激活均比雌性Xa更为显著，这与肝脏疾病中的雄性偏倚相关。值得注意的是，对人类肝脏组织的分析表明，正常Xa具有二分体兆域结构（bipartite mega-domain structure），该结构在纤维化和HCC组织中（无论性别）均被溶解。这种二分体Xa具有肝脏特异性，且与倍性状态相关性很小。此外，通过CRISPR-Cas3删除兆碱基规模的Xa边界会破坏二分体Xa构象，并驱动癌前转变。综上，这项综合分析强调了Xa构象变化在促进HCC发展中的关键作用。

papers.title: Virobiome-mediated regulation of microbiota-gut-brain axis signaling and neuroimmune homeostasis.
papers.authors: Afkhamian, Alireza; Saffari Natanzi, Abolfazl; Jafaridarabjerdi, Mahin; Aghaei, Sara; Haghjou, Ali; Shafiei, Mohammadreza; Bashkandi, Aysa Hasanzade; Shahraki, Sajjad; Reiter, Russel J; Haddad Kashani, Hamed; Yang, Yanchao
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述肠道病毒组通过菌群-肠-脑轴调控神经免疫，虽提及AI建模但无无序蛋白/PPI机制建模，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: The human gut-brain axis (GBA) is increasingly recognized as a complex bidirectional communication system integrating microbial, neural, endocrine, and immune networks that shape neurological health. While bacterial contributions to this dialogue have been extensively characterized, the viral component of the gut ecosystem, the virome, has emerged as an important component associated with host physiological regulation. This review synthesizes evidence suggesting that bacteriophages and eukaryotic viruses may contribute to microbial and immune homeostasis and may influence signaling along the microbiota-gut-brain axis. In experimental studies, Bacteriophages have been shown to influence microbial community structure through lytic and lysogenic cycles, horizontal gene transfer, and metabolic modulation, indirectly regulating production of neuroactive metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids and tryptophan derivatives which in turn have been linked to blood brain barrier integrity and modulate microglial activation. In observational human studies and experimental models, eukaryotic viruses including Epstein Barr virus and cytomegalovirus have been associated with systemic inflammation, molecular mimicry, and cytokine dysregulation, amplifying neuroimmune cascades implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD), multiple sclerosis (MS), autism spectrum disorder (ASD), and major depressive disorder (MDD). The convergence of viral-bacterial interactions highlights a transkingdom signaling network shaping neuroinflammatory tone and influencing disease susceptibility. Emerging experimental strategies, including precision phage therapy, engineered probiotics incorporating CRISPR-based antiviral systems, and fecal virome transplantation (FVT), are being explored as potential approaches to modulate virome-microbiome interactions. Integration of multiomics platforms with artificial intelligence-driven modeling will be critical for clarifying the temporal and mechanistic relationships between virome dynamics and neurological function. Collectively, these insights highlight the gut virobiome as a potentially important contributor to neuroimmune equilibrium and illuminate avenues for microbiome-informed diagnostics and interventions in neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disorders. This review therefore highlights the often underappreciated role of the gut virobiome and proposes an integrative conceptual model linking virome dynamics with microbiota-gut-brain axis signaling.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类肠脑轴（gut-brain axis, GBA）日益被认识到是一个复杂的双向通信系统，整合了微生物、神经、内分泌和免疫网络，塑造神经健康。虽然细菌在这一对话中的贡献已被广泛表征，但肠道生态系统的病毒组分——病毒组（virome）——已成为与宿主生理调节相关的重要成分。本综述综合了表明噬菌体（bacteriophages）和真核病毒（eukaryotic viruses）可能促进微生物和免疫稳态，并可能影响沿微生物群-肠脑轴（microbiota-gut-brain axis）信号传导的证据。在实验研究中，噬菌体已被证明通过裂解和溶原周期、水平基因转移和代谢调节影响微生物群落结构，间接调节神经活性代谢物（如短链脂肪酸和色氨酸衍生物）的产生，而这些代谢物又与血脑屏障完整性相关并调节小胶质细胞激活。在观察性人体研究和实验模型中，包括Epstein-Barr病毒和巨细胞病毒在内的真核病毒与全身性炎症、分子模拟和细胞因子失调相关，放大了与阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）、多发性硬化（multiple sclerosis, MS）、自闭症谱系障碍（autism spectrum disorder, ASD）和重度抑郁障碍（major depressive disorder, MDD）相关的神经免疫级联反应。病毒-细菌相互作用的汇聚突显了一个跨王国信号网络，塑造神经炎症基调并影响疾病易感性。新兴的实验策略，包括精准噬菌体疗法、整合CRISPR抗病毒系统的工程化益生菌以及粪便病毒组移植（fecal virome transplantation, FVT），正在被探索为调节病毒组-微生物组相互作用的潜在方法。将多组学平台与人工智能驱动建模相结合，对于阐明病毒组动态与神经功能之间的时间和机制关系至关重要。总体而言，这些见解强调了肠道病毒组（gut virobiome）作为神经免疫平衡潜在重要贡献者的作用，并为神经退行性和神经精神疾病的微生物组知情诊断和干预开辟了途径。因此，本综述强调了常被低估的肠道病毒组作用，并提出了一个整合性概念模型，将病毒组动态与微生物群-肠脑轴信号传导联系起来。

papers.title: Genetic and biochemical screens identify MGAT1 as a druggable glycosyltransferase target in STK11-mutant lung cancer.
papers.authors: Vassallo, Kiera M; Chen, Ying-Nan P; Handing, Katarzyna B; Lu, Alvin Z; Meier, Samuel R; Liu, Shangtao; Shen, Binzhang; Teng, Teng; Yu, Yi; Ji, Lei; Lazarides, Katherine; Huang, Alan; Min, Chengyin; Haines, Brian B; Mallender, William D; Sun, Sining; Liu, Mu-Sen; Amor, Alvaro J; Whittington, Douglas A; Salerno, Rebecca; Bruzzese, Frank J; Maxwell, John P; Maynard, Andrew; McCarren, Patrick; Come, Jon H; Throner, Scott; Andersen, Jannik N; Zhang, Wenhai; Gueroussov, Serge
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究肺癌中糖基转移酶MGAT1的抑制剂发现与结构，不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作机制或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
papers.abstract: Checkpoint inhibitors are standard-of-care therapies for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but their efficacy is limited in tumors with STK11 mutations, highlighting the need for new therapeutic strategies. Here, we performed complementary in vivo and in vitro CRISPR-Cas9 functional genomic screens to identify genes whose loss restores sensitivity to anti-PD-1 therapy. We found that loss of MGAT1, a Golgi glycosyltransferase critical for the maturation of high-mannose N-glycans into hybrid and complex glycan structures, reversed resistance to anti-PD-1 treatment in syngeneic mouse tumor models harboring STK11 mutations. Parallel co-culture screens with antigen-matched CD8(+) T cells further showed that disruption of N-glycosylation strongly sensitized tumor cells to T cell-mediated killing. Genetic rescue studies demonstrated that this immune-evasion phenotype depends on MGAT1 catalytic activity, supporting direct biochemical interrogation of the enzyme. Using purified human MGAT1 and a UDP-Glo glycosyltransferase assay, we established a tractable screening platform and performed a 500,000-compound biochemical high-throughput screen, identifying an initial hit (compound 1; IC(50) = 197 muM). Subsequent medicinal chemistry optimization delivered progressively more potent analogs, including TNG-9333 (0.814 muM) and TNG-2673 (0.043 muM) and represented a >1000-fold improvement in biochemical potency from the starting hit. Crystal structures of human MGAT1 in apo, UDP-bound, UDP-GlcNAc-bound, and inhibitor-bound states, together with SPR and DSF analyses, revealed that this chemical series engages a previously unrecognized allosteric pocket and inhibits MGAT1 through a UDP-noncompetitive mechanism. Collectively, our work implicates N-glycosylation as a key mediator of immune evasion and establishes MGAT1 as a ligandable, structurally tractable target for small-molecule drug discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 检查点抑制剂 (checkpoint inhibitors) 是非小细胞肺癌 (non-small cell lung cancer, NSCLC) 的标准疗法，但在携带STK11突变的肿瘤中疗效有限，凸显了对新治疗策略的需求。在此，我们通过互补的体内和体外CRISPR-Cas9功能基因组筛选，鉴定了其缺失可恢复抗PD-1疗法敏感性的基因。我们发现，MGAT1（一种对高甘露糖N-聚糖成熟为杂合型和复杂型聚糖结构至关重要的高尔基体糖基转移酶）的缺失，逆转了携带STK11突变的同源小鼠肿瘤模型对抗PD-1治疗的耐药性。与抗原匹配的CD8(+) T细胞进行的平行共培养筛选进一步表明，破坏N-糖基化 (N-glycosylation) 能强烈增敏肿瘤细胞对T细胞介导杀伤的敏感性。遗传拯救研究证明，这种免疫逃逸表型依赖于MGAT1的催化活性，支持对该酶进行直接的生化探究。利用纯化的人源MGAT1和UDP-Glo糖基转移酶 (UDP-Glo glycosyltransferase) 检测，我们建立了一个易操作的筛选平台，并进行了50万化合物的生化高通量筛选，鉴定出一个初始命中化合物（化合物1；IC(50) = 197 muM）。随后的药物化学优化得到了效力逐步增强的类似物，包括TNG-9333 (0.814 muM) 和TNG-2673 (0.043 muM)，相较于起始命中化合物，生化效力提升了超过1000倍。人源MGAT1在无配体、UDP结合、UDP-GlcNAc结合及抑制剂结合状态下的晶体结构，结合SPR和DSF分析，揭示该化学系列作用于一个先前未被识别的别构口袋 (allosteric pocket)，并通过UDP非竞争性机制抑制MGAT1。总体而言，我们的工作将N-糖基化 (N-glycosylation) 确定为免疫逃逸的关键介质，并将MGAT1确立为一个可配体结合、结构易处理的靶点，用于小分子药物发现。

papers.title: Architecture of a DNA-guided Cas12a.
papers.authors: Ocampo, Rodrigo Fregoso; Orosco, Carlos; Huang, Boyu; West, Madeline S; Parker, Bay; Jain, Piyush K; Taylor, David W
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析了Cas12a与DNA引导RNA靶标的结构，不涉及无序蛋白或相分离，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: CRISPR-Cas systems have largely been restricted to RNA-guided nucleases. Here, we present the cryo-electron microscopy structure of Acidaminococcus sp. Cas12a bound to a pseudo-DNA (PsiDNA) guide and RNA target, revealing how Cas12a can accomplish DNA-guided RNA recognition. The PsiDNA hairpin bridges the recognition and nuclease lobes, mimicking a PAM-proximal duplex and positioning the spacer to allow formation of a canonical RNA-DNA heteroduplex along the recognition lobe. This provides a structural framework for its activity and provides a potential blueprint for future engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: CRISPR-Cas系统在很大程度上仅限于RNA引导的核酸酶。在此，我们展示了Acidaminococcus sp. Cas12a与伪DNA（PsiDNA）引导RNA及RNA靶标结合的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了Cas12a如何实现DNA引导的RNA识别。PsiDNA发夹结构桥接识别叶和核酸酶叶，模拟PAM近端双链体，并将间隔区定位以允许沿识别叶形成典型的RNA-DNA异源双链体。这为其活性提供了结构框架，并为未来的工程改造提供了潜在蓝图。

papers.title: Molecular characterization of vitellogenin and its receptor with CRISPR-based sgRNA validation in the legume pod borer, Maruca vitrata (Geyer) (Lepidoptera: Crambidae).
papers.authors: Pradeep, Chalapathi; Sujatha, Parvathy Madhusoodanan; Nagesha, Somakalahalli Narasimhappa; Asokan, Ramasamy; Karuppannasamy, Ashok
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文克隆并表征了豆荚螟的卵黄原蛋白及其受体，通过同源建模和蛋白-蛋白对接分析其互作，但对象为昆虫生殖蛋白（非无序蛋白/IDR），且无AI/物理模拟方法贡献，与本课题关联度低。
papers.abstract: Maruca vitrata, the legume pod borer, causes yield losses of up to 80% in grain legumes. Increasing insecticide resistance and environmental concerns necessitate sustainable pest management alternatives. In the present study, the complete vitellogenin (Vg) coding sequence (CDS), a key reproductive gene involved in oogenesis and embryonic development, was cloned and molecularly characterised from M. vitrata. The assembled Vg CDS ( approximately 5.3 kb) shared 99.04% sequence identity with the reported M. vitrata Vg sequence (MG799570.1). Phylogenetic analysis demonstrated close evolutionary association with related Lepidopteran species, while protein domain analysis identified three conserved domains, namely LPD_N, DUF1943, and VWD. Among these, the single exon-encoded LPD_N domain was selected as the target region for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated editing. Homology models of Vg and vitellogenin receptor (VgR) (Global Model Quality Estimation (GMQE): 0.58 and 0.51) showed a favourable interaction by protein-protein docking (score: -295.66). Three single-guide RNAs (sgRNAs) were designed, synthesised through in-vitro transcription, and evaluated using in vitro cleavage assays. sgRNA1 targeting the LPD_N domain and sgRNA2 targeting the signal peptide region exhibited efficient site-specific cleavage activity, whereas sgRNA3 failed to induce cleavage because of an unfavourable secondary structure that likely impaired Cas9-sgRNA complex formation. Overall, this study provides the first CRISPR-oriented functional characterisation and sgRNA validation of the M. vitrata Vg gene, together with structural characterisation of VgR and Vg-VgR interaction analysis, providing preliminary molecular resources for future CRISPR/Cas9 studies and supporting future embryo microinjection and heritable genome editing for sustainable management of M. vitrata.
papers.abstract_zh: Maruca vitrata（豆荚螟）是豆科作物上的重要害虫，可导致籽粒豆类产量损失高达80%。日益严重的杀虫剂抗性和环境问题促使人们寻求可持续的害虫管理替代方案。本研究从M. vitrata中克隆并分子表征了卵黄原蛋白（vitellogenin, Vg）的完整编码序列（CDS），该基因是参与卵子发生和胚胎发育的关键生殖基因。组装得到的Vg CDS（约5.3 kb）与已报道的M. vitrata Vg序列（MG799570.1）具有99.04%的序列一致性。系统发育分析显示其与相关鳞翅目物种具有密切的进化关联，而蛋白结构域分析鉴定出三个保守结构域，即LPD_N、DUF1943和VWD。其中，由单一外显子编码的LPD_N结构域被选为CRISPR/Cas9介导编辑的靶区域。Vg和卵黄原蛋白受体（vitellogenin receptor, VgR）的同源模型（全局模型质量估计（GMQE）：0.58和0.51）通过蛋白-蛋白对接显示出有利的相互作用（得分：-295.66）。设计并合成了三个单导向RNA（sgRNAs），通过体外转录合成，并使用体外切割实验进行评估。靶向LPD_N结构域的sgRNA1和靶向信号肽区域的sgRNA2表现出高效的位点特异性切割活性，而sgRNA3因不利的二级结构未能诱导切割，该结构可能损害了Cas9-sgRNA复合物的形成。总体而言，本研究提供了M. vitrata Vg基因的首次CRISPR导向功能表征和sgRNA验证，以及VgR的结构表征和Vg-VgR相互作用分析，为未来CRISPR/Cas9研究提供了初步分子资源，并支持未来胚胎显微注射和可遗传基因组编辑，以实现对M. vitrata的可持续管理。

papers.title: PDK1 signaling in cancer: Current status and future perspectives.
papers.authors: Honnasiddappa, Darshana Ballagere; Ramar, Mohankumar; Biju, Tincy; Sajjan, Mallikarjun; Venkatesh, Chidananda; Mahadeva, Nayan Kumar; Kunjiappan, Selvaraj; Ammunje, Damodar Nayak; Pavadai, Parasuraman
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述PDK1在癌症中的信号调控与治疗靶向，不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作机制建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Dysregulation of signaling pathways governing cell growth, survival, metabolism, angiogenesis, invasion, metastasis, and therapeutic response drives cancer progression. The AGC family of kinases, such as AKT, S6K, SGK, RSK, and PKC, is important for downstream signaling. The 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase-1 protein (PDK1), encoded by the PDPK1 gene, phosphorylates activation-loop residues in these kinases and links phosphoinositide signaling to cellular growth, survival, metabolism, and transformation. The structure, regulation, cancer-associated functions, and therapeutic targeting of PDK1 are critically reviewed, with a focus on the pleckstrin homology domain, PIF pocket-mediated substrate docking, the kinase domain, and reported non-catalytic interactions. Experimental results from breast, lung, gastric, liver, hematological, and melanoma models suggest that dysregulated PDK1 signaling can increase the output of the PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway, invasion, metabolic adaptation, and resistance to specific hormonal, chemotherapeutic, and targeted therapies. In some preclinical models, genetic suppression of PDK1 using siRNA, shRNA, or CRISPR-based methods has been shown to slow tumor cell growth and restore drug sensitivity. However, PDK1 remains an unvalidated therapeutic target in the clinic. There is no selective PDK1 inhibitor that has been clinically approved, and most pharmacological candidates are based on biochemical and cellular data. There is limited genetic evidence and in vivo evidence, and no validated clinical evidence specific to PDK1. Emerging PIF-pocket ligands, dual-site inhibitors, allosteric modulators, and protein-degradation strategies are therefore investigational strategies that need to be improved in terms of selectivity, pharmacokinetic characterization, tumor-context validation, and biomarker-guided evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 调控细胞生长、存活、代谢、血管生成、侵袭、转移及治疗反应的信号通路失调驱动癌症进展。AGC家族激酶，如AKT、S6K、SGK、RSK和PKC，对下游信号传导至关重要。由PDPK1基因编码的3-磷酸肌醇依赖性蛋白激酶-1 (PDK1) 可磷酸化这些激酶中的激活环残基，并将磷酸肌醇信号传导与细胞生长、存活、代谢和转化联系起来。本文对PDK1的结构、调控、癌症相关功能及治疗靶向进行了批判性综述，重点关注pleckstrin同源结构域、PIF口袋介导的底物对接、激酶结构域以及已报道的非催化相互作用。来自乳腺癌、肺癌、胃癌、肝癌、血液肿瘤和黑色素瘤模型的实验结果表明，失调的PDK1信号可增强PI3K-AKT-mTOR通路的输出、侵袭、代谢适应以及对特定激素疗法、化疗和靶向治疗的耐药性。在一些临床前模型中，使用siRNA、shRNA或CRISPR方法对PDK1进行基因抑制已被证明可减缓肿瘤细胞生长并恢复药物敏感性。然而，PDK1在临床上仍是一个未经验证的治疗靶点。目前尚无选择性PDK1抑制剂获得临床批准，大多数药理学候选药物基于生化和细胞数据。针对PDK1的遗传学证据和体内证据有限，且缺乏经过验证的临床证据。因此，新兴的PIF口袋配体、双位点抑制剂、变构调节剂和蛋白质降解策略仍处于研究阶段，需要在选择性、药代动力学表征、肿瘤背景验证和生物标志物指导评估方面加以改进。

papers.title: Emerging strategies for regulating Cas12a and Cas13a trans-cleavage activity in biosensing.
papers.authors: Wang, Xiaohui; Huang, Yaru; Zhang, Lei; Zheng, Le
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述CRISPR-Cas12a/13a反式切割活性调控策略用于生物传感，不涉及无序蛋白或蛋白-蛋白互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: CRISPR-Cas12a and Cas13a have become widely used platforms for molecular diagnostics and biosensing, because target recognition can trigger collateral nucleic acid cleavage for signal amplification. Leveraging this mechanism, numerous biosensing platforms have been developed with high sensitivity, high specificity, and compatibility with point-of-care testing. However, their analytical performance depends strongly on the regulation of trans-cleavage activity. This review summarizes recent advances in the molecular basis and activity regulation of CRISPR-Cas12a- and Cas13a-based biosensing systems. We discuss the target-recognition and conformational activation mechanisms underlying Cas12a and Cas13a trans-cleavage. We then examine how Cas effector properties, crRNA architecture and composition, activator accessibility and structure, reaction conditions, and reporter design regulate target-induced activation and signal output. We further highlight the use of these strategies for controlled activation, tunable signal generation, and broader biosensing applications. By organizing these strategies across different regulatory layers, this review aims to provide a framework for designing more controllable and adaptable CRISPR trans-cleavage biosensing systems.
papers.abstract_zh: CRISPR-Cas12a和Cas13a已成为分子诊断和生物传感领域广泛使用的平台，因为靶标识别可触发侧支核酸切割以实现信号放大。利用这一机制，已开发出众多具有高灵敏度、高特异性且适用于即时检测（point-of-care testing）的生物传感平台。然而，其分析性能强烈依赖于反式切割活性（trans-cleavage activity）的调控。本综述总结了基于CRISPR-Cas12a和Cas13a的生物传感系统在分子基础与活性调控方面的最新进展。我们讨论了Cas12a和Cas13a反式切割背后的靶标识别与构象激活机制。随后，我们考察了Cas效应蛋白特性、crRNA结构与组成、激活子的可及性与结构、反应条件以及报告分子设计如何调控靶标诱导的激活与信号输出。我们进一步强调了这些策略在可控激活、可调信号生成以及更广泛的生物传感应用中的运用。通过将这些策略组织到不同的调控层面，本综述旨在为设计更可控、更适应性强的CRISPR反式切割生物传感系统提供一个框架。

papers.title: BioCNT-TLS engineered systemic mobile resistome for sustainable crop protection.
papers.authors: Li, Wenbo; Farooq, Tahir; Hussain, Muhammad Dilshad; Brosnan, Christopher A; Chen, Huanhuan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述了碳纳米管与tRNA样结构结合用于作物保护的RNAi递送系统，不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: The global agricultural sector faces an existential threat from viral quasispecies that bypass traditional resistance through high-frequency mutation and rapid systemic colonization. Conventional strategies, including chemical pesticides and transgenic modifications, are increasingly constrained by environmental toxicity, regulatory hurdles, and the biological arms race of viral evasion. This review critically expands upon the transformative potential of biocompatible carbon nanotubes conjugated with tRNA-like structures as a non-transgenic, systemic delivery platform for RNA interference effectors. We analyze the mechanistic synergy between nanomaterial-mediated incorporation and vascular trafficking, proposing a systemic mobile resistome concept, in which BioCNT-TLS complexes may provide transgene-free, RNA-mediated interference distributed across aerial tissues from a single foliar application, an effect demonstrated in a single recent study and not yet validated at the whole-plant or field scale. By synthesizing data on RNAi pyramiding, spray-to-edit CRISPR technologies, and the ecotoxicological footprint of carbon nanomaterials, we provide a blueprint for the future of precision crop protection.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球农业部门正面临来自病毒准种（viral quasispecies）的生存威胁，这些准种通过高频突变和快速系统性定殖绕过传统抗性。包括化学农药和转基因修饰在内的传统策略，日益受到环境毒性、监管障碍以及病毒逃逸的生物学军备竞赛的制约。本综述批判性地扩展了与tRNA样结构（tRNA-like structures）偶联的生物相容性碳纳米管（biocompatible carbon nanotubes）作为非转基因、系统性递送平台用于RNA干扰效应因子的变革潜力。我们分析了纳米材料介导的掺入与维管运输之间的机制协同作用，提出了系统性移动抗性组（systemic mobile resistome）概念，其中BioCNT-TLS复合物可能通过单次叶面施用，提供无转基因、RNA介导的干扰，并分布至地上组织，这一效应仅在近期一项研究中得到展示，尚未在整株或田间尺度上得到验证。通过综合RNAi金字塔化（RNAi pyramiding）、喷雾编辑CRISPR技术（spray-to-edit CRISPR）以及碳纳米材料生态毒理学足迹的数据，我们为精准作物保护的未来提供了蓝图。

papers.title: Evaluating the pathogenic significance of unique chromosomal variants in craniosynostosis using patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells and mouse modelling.
papers.authors: Korona, Dagmara; Hashimoto, Akiko Soneda; Pei, Yang; Calpena, Eduardo; Sloane-Stanley, Jackie; Riva, Simone G; Schwessinger, Ron; Forzano, Francesca; Chintawar, Satyan; Duggal, Galbha; Wall, Steven A; Hughes, Jim R; Twigg, Stephen R F; Wilkie, Andrew O M
papers.journal: Genetics in medicine : official journal of the American College of Medical Genetics
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究用患者iPSC和CRISPR小鼠模型评估颅缝早闭相关染色体结构变异对FGF基因的调控影响，涉及TAD结构预测，但对象非无序蛋白/IDR，无PPI机制建模，也无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Unravelling causal links between unique structural/copy-number variants (SV/CNV) and associated phenotypes is essential for correct genetic counselling. We investigated two families in which patients with craniosynostosis had SV/CNV potentially dysregulating a fibroblast growth factor (FGF)-encoding gene; a 730 kb dup(4)(q21.21) including FGF5; and a complex 568 kb interspersed 13q12.11 duplication, located 841 kb from FGF9. METHODS: We combined bioinformatic predictions of altered topologically-associating domain (TAD) structure, with experimental analysis (RNA- and ATAC- [assay for transposase-accessible chromatin] sequencing) of patient induced pluripotent stem cell lines (iPSCs) differentiated to neural crest (NCC) and osteoprogenitor (OPC) identities. For the dup(4)(q21.21) we generated a mouse bearing an equivalent rearrangement using CRISPR-Cas9 targeting. RESULTS: TAD analysis suggested potential dysregulation of the FGF5/FGF9 gene by bringing it into a novel genomic milieu. The RNA- and ATAC-seq assays demonstrated FGF5/FGF9 upregulation (2.7-18x) and local opening of chromatin, in 3/4 cell lines. For the dup(4)(q21.21), a causal role was supported by the mouse model, whereas interpretation of the 13q12.11 SV is confounded by a co-existing FOXP2 pathogenic variant. CONCLUSION: Patient iPSC-differentiated NCC and OPC lines, combined with TAD-based modelling to generate testable functional hypotheses, provide valuable functional evidence when evaluating causation of unique SV/CNV in craniosynostosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：揭示独特的结构变异/拷贝数变异（SV/CNV）与相关表型之间的因果联系，对于正确的遗传咨询至关重要。我们研究了两例颅缝早闭患者携带可能失调成纤维细胞生长因子（FGF）编码基因的SV/CNV的家系：一个包含FGF5的730 kb dup(4)(q21.21)；以及一个位于FGF9下游841 kb处的复杂568 kb散布性13q12.11重复。方法：我们结合了对拓扑关联结构域（TAD）改变的生物信息学预测，以及对患者诱导多能干细胞系（iPSCs）分化为神经嵴细胞（NCC）和成骨前体细胞（OPC）身份后的实验分析（RNA测序和ATAC- [转座酶可及染色质测定] 测序）。针对dup(4)(q21.21)，我们利用CRISPR-Cas9靶向技术生成了携带等效重排的小鼠。结果：TAD分析表明，FGF5/FGF9基因可能因被置于新的基因组环境而失调。RNA-seq和ATAC-seq检测显示，在3/4的细胞系中，FGF5/FGF9表达上调（2.7-18倍）并伴随局部染色质开放。对于dup(4)(q21.21)，小鼠模型支持其因果作用，而13q12.11 SV的解释因共存的FOXP2致病性变异而复杂化。结论：患者iPSC分化的NCC和OPC细胞系，结合基于TAD的建模以生成可检验的功能假说，为评估颅缝早闭中独特SV/CNV的因果关系提供了有价值的功能证据。

papers.title: A host-encoded prophage targets a Candidate Phyla Radiation bacterium and shapes episymbiotic interactions.
papers.authors: Kumar, Ajay; Nahar, Nusrat; Chouhan, Deepak; McLean, Jeffrey S; Bor, Batbileg; Dong, Pu-Ting; He, Xuesong
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定首个靶向CPR细菌的噬菌体Xhp1，研究其与宿主及CPR细菌的感染动态，但对象非无序蛋白/IDR/相分离，无PPI机制建模，无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: The Patescibacteriota, also known as the Candidate Phyla Radiation (CPR), represent a large lineage of ultrasmall bacteria with highly reduced genomes and obligate dependence on bacterial hosts. Although genomic analyses have revealed CRISPR-Cas and restriction-modification systems in many CPR genomes, no cognate bacteriophages (phages) have been isolated, leaving CPR-phage interactions unexplored. Nanosynbacter lyticus TM7x, the first cultivated CPR bacterium, grows episymbiotically on its host, Schaalia odontolytica XH001, in the human oral microbiome. Here, we identify Xhp1, an inducible prophage of XH001 that is preferentially activated during episymbiosis with TM7x. Released Xhp1 particles infect prophage-free XH001 via distinct strategies determined by host growth mode, establishing lysogeny under planktonic conditions but driving lytic infection during surface-associated growth. Xhp1 also binds efficiently to TM7x and exhibits limited infection under the conditions tested, indicating direct phage-CPR interactions. Importantly, TM7x modulates Xhp1 availability in a spatially dependent manner. In planktonic culture, free-floating TM7x reduces lysogenic conversion of XH001DeltaXhp1, consistent with TM7x acting as a phage sink that lowers effective phage concentration. In contrast, during surface-associated growth, TM7x increases XH001DeltaXhp1 susceptibility to lytic infection, likely by locally concentrating phage particles within a constrained niche. These results demonstrate that CPR bacteria can regulate viral encounter rates through spatial organization. In spatially structured environments such as oral biofilms, such modulation may shape infection dynamics and community structure. Together, this work characterizes the first CPR-targeting phage and reveals a an important role for phages in CPR-host bacteria interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: Patescibacteriota（也称为候选门级辐射类群CPR）代表一个由超小型细菌组成的大型谱系，其基因组高度缩减，并依赖细菌宿主生存。尽管基因组分析已在许多CPR基因组中揭示CRISPR-Cas和限制-修饰系统，但尚未分离出相应的噬菌体（phages），因此CPR与噬菌体的相互作用仍未被探索。Nanosynbacter lyticus TM7x是首个被培养的CPR细菌，它在人类口腔微生物组中以其宿主Schaalia odontolytica XH001为外共生体生长。在此，我们鉴定出Xhp1，这是XH001的一个可诱导的前噬菌体，在TM7x外共生期间被优先激活。释放的Xhp1颗粒通过由宿主生长模式决定的独特策略感染无前噬菌体的XH001：在浮游条件下建立溶原性，但在表面相关生长期间驱动裂解性感染。Xhp1还能有效结合TM7x，并在测试条件下表现出有限的感染，表明存在直接的噬菌体-CPR相互作用。重要的是，TM7x以空间依赖的方式调节Xhp1的可利用性。在浮游培养中，游离的TM7x降低了XH001ΔXhp1的溶原性转化，这与TM7x作为噬菌体汇降低有效噬菌体浓度的作用一致。相反，在表面相关生长期间，TM7x增加了XH001ΔXhp1对裂解性感染的易感性，这可能是通过在受限生态位内局部浓缩噬菌体颗粒实现的。这些结果表明，CPR细菌可以通过空间组织调控病毒接触率。在口腔生物膜等空间结构化环境中，这种调控可能塑造感染动态和群落结构。总之，这项工作表征了首个靶向CPR的噬菌体，并揭示了噬菌体在CPR-宿主细菌相互作用中的重要角色。

papers.title: Clonal diversity and genetic characteristics of extraintestinal pathogenic Escherichia coli in northern Japan: identification of the potentially prevalent clones phylogroup B2-ST357 and ST1193.
papers.authors: Suzuki, Satoshi; Aung, Meiji Soe; Matsubara, Kana; Kimura, Yuuki; Ito, Masahiko; Urushibara, Noriko; Kawaguchiya, Mitsuyo; Ohashi, Nobuhide; Higuchi, Toru; Takahashi, Satoshi; Kobayashi, Nobumichi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究调查日本北部肠外致病性大肠杆菌的克隆多样性和遗传特征，与无序蛋白/IDR/相分离/PPI机制建模及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Extraintestinal pathogenic Escherichia coli (ExPEC) is a leading cause of bloodstream and urinary tract infections, often showing multiple drug resistance associated with production of extended-spectrum beta-lactamases (ESBLs). The present study aimed at revealing the clonal structure and diversity of ExPEC in northern Japan and its relation to antimicrobial resistance (AMR) profiles and determinants, and genetic features. METHODS: Phylogenetic group and sequence type (ST) based on MLST scheme were determined for clinical isolates of ExPEC. PCR and sequencing were used to identify AMR determinants, virulence factors and CRISPR-Cas systems, along with antimicrobial susceptibility test by the broth microdilution method. RESULTS: A total of 454 ExPEC isolates (150 from blood and 304 from urine/other specimens) were collected for 6 months. The major phylogenetic group was B2 (79.5%), and the remaining were D (9.9%), B1 (5.7%), F (3.1%), and other groups (A, C, G; 1.8% in all). Among the 68 STs identified, ST131 was the most common (33.7%), followed by ST95 (15.6%), ST357 (9.9%), ST1193 (7%), and ST73 (4%), all of which belonged to phylogroup B2. Five types of ESBL genes including the dominant bla(CTX-M-15) or bla(CTX-M-27) were detected in 17% of isolates, which belonged mostly to the ST131 complex. CRISPR-Cas type I-E was present mostly in phylogroup B1 and D, while I-F in 3 STs of phylogroup B2. CONCLUSION: The potentially increased prevalence of ST357, ST1193, and animal-related clones was revealed to be novel clonal features of ExPEC in northern Japan.
